content:
The following metrics apply to the default Bounded blocking buﬀer that OpenSearch Ingestion
automatically conﬁgures for all pipelines.
Each metric is preﬁxed by the sub-pipeline name and buﬀer name, in the format
<sub_pipeline_name><buffer_name><metric_name>. For example, the full name of
the recordsWritten.count metric for a sub-pipeline named my-pipeline would be my-
pipeline.BlockingBuffer.recordsWritten.count.
Metric suﬃx
Description
recordsWritten.count
The number of records written to a buﬀer.
Relevant statistics: Sum
Dimension: PipelineName
recordsRead.count
The number of records read from a buﬀer.
Relevant statistics: Sum
Dimension: PipelineName
recordsInFlight.value
The number of unchecked records read from a buﬀer.
Relevant statistics: Average
Dimension: PipelineName
recordsInBuffer.value
The number of records currently in a buﬀer.
Relevant statistics: Average
